payload.summary: Reviewed the scenario/test retune and did not find a correctness or safety regression attributable to this diff. Targeted checks passed for `cargo test -p tank_core test_planted_tank_day_night_cycle -- --nocapture` and `cargo test -p tank_scenarios -- --nocapture`. I also verified that the `tank_harness` `medium_planted` carbon-budget failure reproduces on a clean `HEAD` archive, so I did not count that pre-existing issue against these changes.
